Darüber hinaus optimierst du Fundraising- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen und stellst Datenqualität und Datenintegrität sicher. Damit sorgst du dafür, dass Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen datenbasiert geplant, segmentiert, ausgewertet und optimiert werden können. Mit KPI-Reportings, Tests und Analysen lieferst du belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Weiterentwicklung von Fundraising, Mobilisierung und Unterstützer:innen-Journeys. Im Einzelnen bedeutet das Du segmentierst und bereitest Daten für Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen vor Du entwickelst, pflegst und dokumentierst SQL-Abfragen und wiederkehrende Auswertungslogiken Du wertest Fundraising-, Engagement- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen entlang vereinbarter KPIs aus Du erstellst Monatsreportings und Dashboards mit den wichtigsten Steuerungskennzahlen Du bereitest A/B- und multivariate Tests vor, wertest sie aus und leitest Learnings ab Du analysierst Unterstützer:innen-Journeys, Zielgruppen und Segmente als Grundlage für Optimierung Du erstellst ad-hoc-Auswertungen und Handlungsempfehlungen für strategische Entscheidungen Dein Profil Idealerweise hast du einen Studienabschluss oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Fundraising, BWL, Controlling, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Statistik oder Data Science. Wir sind aber auch offen für Quereinsteiger:innen mit entsprechenden nachgewiesenen Qualifikationen und Referenzen. Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Digital Fundraising einer Non-Profit-Organisation. Du pflegst einen sicheren Umgang mit Instrumenten der qualitativen und quantitativen Datenanalyse inkl. Tracking- und Analyse Tools. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken und CRM Systemen. Du hast Erfahrung mit A/B- und multivariatem Testing. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Asana, monday.com, Jira oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen und nutzt sie, um Aufgaben, Abstimmungen und Projektfortschritte übersichtlich zu organisieren. (wir arbeiten mit Asana) Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig mit einer hohen Problemlösungskompetenz. Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weil z. B. eine Deadline näher rückt, bleibst du entspannt. Auf Unvorhergesehenes reagierst du flexibel und suchst passende Alternativen. Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen - auch wenn nicht alle an einem Ort sind. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung damit, KI-Tools reflektiert im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen und weißt, dass gute Ergebnisse klare Aufgabenstellungen, ausreichend Kontext und eine sorgfältige Prüfung brauchen. Du identifizierst dich mit unserer Vision, Mission und Kultur . Was wir dir bieten Eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Stelle auf 35-Basis: Als Teil des F&E-Teams bewirkst du direkt gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und verbesserst den Tierschutz. Home-Office-Möglichkeiten: Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und arbeitest mit flexiblen, familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten im hybriden Modell (Homeoffice & Büro). Professionelles Team: Kollegialer, offener Austausch in einem motivierten Team Hundefreundliche Büros inkl. „hundefreie“ Bereiche für Allergiker:innen sowie ergonomische Arbeitsplätze Attraktive Vergütung: Unbefristet, Jahresgehalt zwischen 45.996,00 € und 52.895,40 € (erfahrungsbasiert) + Bonuszahlungen Benefits: Cafeteria-Modell (finanzielle Vorteile, Deutschlandticket oder zusätzliche Urlaubstage), Zuschüsse zu Gesundheitsleistungen (z. B. B12 + D Bluttests) und betriebliche Altersvorsorge Weiterbildung: Aktive Förderung von Fort- und Weiterbildungen Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? title: Data Operations & Labeling Specialist (all genders)
description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We're focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe — today. About the team The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy. Your mission You are the crucial bridge between our raw field data, our external labeling partners, and our internal Machine Learning teams. Your mission is to ensure our AI models are trained on the highest quality data possible. You will own the day-to-day operations of the data labeling lifecycle: curating raw data, preparing annotation batches, managing vendor communication, and rigorously assessing the quality of incoming labels. If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and interested in the intersection of data operations and Computer Vision, this is the perfect place to start your career in AI. Responsibilities Own the day-to-day data labeling lifecycle: curate raw field data, create annotation batches, and prepare deliveries for external labeling companies. Serve as the primary point of contact for external data annotation vendors, clarifying edge cases and providing feedback on labeling guidelines. Conduct rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) assessments on incoming label deliveries, track error rates, and create performance reports. Support data curation efforts, filtering and selecting the most valuable sensor data (images, video, lidar) for model training. Work closely with ML Engineers to understand their data needs, edge cases, and specific Computer Vision requirements. Help maintain the data catalog by ensuring incoming datasets are properly tagged and logged. Qualifications Highly organized and detail-oriented: you can manage multiple data batches, vendor deliveries, and QA processes simultaneously without dropping the ball. title: Data Analyst (all genders)
description: Jede Entscheidung bei MUVN hängt an einer Zahl. Niemand soll sie suchen müssen. MUVN verbindet Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Kein neuer Fuhrpark, keine neue Logistik. Bessere Nutzung von dem, was ohnehin unterwegs ist. Unser Marktplatz wächst über Korridore, also über einzelne Strecken, die dicht genug werden, um von selbst zu tragen. Ob eine Strecke trägt, ist keine Meinungsfrage, sondern eine Messung. Dafür bauen wir das MUVN Brain: eine verbundene Schicht über unseren Systemen, in der Kennzahlen einmal definiert sind und Menschen wie AI-Agents dieselbe Antwort bekommen. Es wird immer mehr als ein System geben. Der Unterschied liegt darin, ob sie miteinander reden. Du baust das. Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Datenstelle, berichtest an unseren CFO und arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründungsteam, Marketing und Operations. Du erbst keine Datenplattform, du entscheidest, was sie wird. Und du beantwortest die Fragen, an denen bei uns Geld hängt: Welcher Korridor kippt als Nächstes. Wo verlieren wir Nachfrage. Welcher Kanal bringt Matches statt Downloads. Du arbeitest dabei AI-First: AI übernimmt die Ausführung, dir gehören Intention, logisches Denken und Korrektheit. Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Vollzeit 🚀 Aufgaben Eine Wahrheit, nicht fünf Du definierst unsere Kernkennzahlen über den gesamten Funnel, einmal verbindlich, mit klarer Namenskonvention und einer Definition pro Metrik. Teile davon existieren bereits, sie sind nur nirgends operationalisiert. Du gleichst die Quellen ab, erklärst Abweichungen und sorgst dafür, dass eine Frage genau eine Antwort hat, egal wer sie stellt. Den Marktplatz messbar machen Unsere Analyseeinheit ist der Korridor, nicht die Stadt und nicht das Land. Du machst Angebot, Nachfrage, Fill Rate und Time-to-Match auf dieser Ebene sichtbar, inklusive der Fälle, die in keinem Standard-Funnel auftauchen. Ein Fahrer, der nichts findet, ist bei uns ein Signal, kein fehlender Datenpunkt. Das MUVN Brain bauen Heute: direktes SQL, Python-Skripte, API-Pulls. Du überführst das in einen leichtgewichtigen, verbundenen Stack und entscheidest über Architektur und Tools, vom Warehouse über den Transformations-Layer bis zum BI-Tool. Jedes Werkzeug kommt an dem Punkt rein, an dem es seine Kosten verdient, nicht früher. Lieber fünf verlässliche Modelle als fünfzig halb vertraute. Pipelines, denen man vertraut Du integrierst unsere Quellen mit Pipelines, die idempotent, testbar und dokumentiert sind. Du baust Validierung zwischen den Quellen und fängst Diskrepanzen ab, bevor sie ein Meeting erreichen. Wenn etwas bricht, findest du die Ursache statt das Symptom und planst Backfills mit Prüfung davor und danach. Analysen, die Entscheidungen tragen Wiederkehrendes Management-Reporting, Kohorten, Retention, Pricing, Funnel, Marketing-Performance Ende zu Ende. Ad-hoc-Fragen beantwortest du schnell. Die, die immer wiederkommen, überführst du in Self-Serve-Reports, damit das Team sich selbst bedient. Das Team unabhängig von dir machen Du nimmst Anforderungen von Gründern, Marketing und Operations auf und übersetzt sie in Modelle, die wiederverwendbar sind. Du dokumentierst Definitionen, Annahmen und Sonderfälle dort, wo sie hingehören, im Code und in der Doku, nicht in deinem Kopf. Datenfragen sollen nicht bei dir enden. AI-Agents als Teil des Systems Du baust und iterierst Agents für klar umrissene Aufgaben: wiederkehrende Reports, Dokumentation, Datenqualitätschecks. Du pflegst die maschinenlesbaren Kontextdateien, die unser Brain überhaupt erst nutzbar machen, mit unseren Konventionen, Definitionen und Domänenregeln. Du prüfst, was AI produziert, bevor es zählt. Die Korrektheit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool. Qualifikation Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst:in, Analytics Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und schon einmal ein Reporting von null aufgebaut, nicht nur eines gepflegt. SQL ist für dich Handwerk, nicht Hürde: Window Functions, CTEs, Query-Optimierung, und genug Tiefe, um einen Execution Plan zu lesen und ein Performanceproblem selbst zu finden. Python nutzt du für Analysen und Pipeline-Arbeit. Was diese Rolle von klassischer Analyse unterscheidet: Du bekommst keine Tickets. Du bekommst Entscheidungen, die anstehen, und findest selbst heraus, welche Zahl sie tragen muss, wer sie liest und was es dazu schon gibt. Was bei uns funktioniert: Du fragst zuerst, welche Entscheidung an der Zahl hängt, bevor du die erste Query schreibst. Du formulierst eine Hypothese, bevor du sie prüfst, und änderst sie, wenn die Daten etwas anderes sagen. Du merkst, wenn eine Zahl zu gut ist, um wahr zu sein, und gehst ihr nach, bevor sie in ein Meeting kommt. Du arbeitest eigenständig und meldest dich, wenn etwas klemmt, nicht erst im Wochenmeeting. Du misst dich selbst an Ergebnissen, bevor es jemand anderes tut. Du dokumentierst so, dass die nächste Person dich nicht fragen muss. Du denkst in Kosten, bei Compute, Speicherung und Pipeline-Design, und handelst danach. Du teilst, was du weißt. Wissen, das nur bei dir liegt, ist bei uns ein Risiko, kein Vorteil. Solides Analytics-Fundament: Kohorten, Funnels, Unit Economics und statistisches Grundverständnis. Praxiserfahrung mit Produkt- und Marketing-Analytics-Tools wie Mixpanel, GA4, Mobile Attribution oder Vergleichbarem. Engineering-Grundprinzipien auf Datenarbeit angewendet: Modularität, Idempotenz, Testbarkeit als Default. Datenschutzbewusste Modellierung ist für dich selbstverständlich, wir arbeiten mit Zahlungs- und Personendaten. AI-gestützte Workflows sind dein Alltag, mit voller Verantwortung für das Ergebnis. Ein Plus, kein Muss: dbt oder ein Modern Data Stack, den du selbst eingeführt hast. Erfahrung mit Payments-Daten. Marktplatz- oder Plattformhintergrund, also Liquidität, Take Rate, Angebots- und Nachfragedynamik. Early-Stage-Erfahrung, du hast schon ohne Playbook gearbeitet. Deutsch und Englisch fließend. Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss. Benefits Dein Marktplatz, deine Zahlen: echte Ownership von Tag 1 Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Arbeite, wann es für dich am besten passt Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: kein HR-Filter, keine Hierarchie dazwischen Karriereperspektive: baue langfristig dein eigenes Team auf, in DACH und Europa Hybrides Arbeiten & Remote: Flexibilität ist bei uns Programm Offsites mit dem Team: Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr Free MUVN Rides: Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren Corporate Benefits: Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops Mehr Infos zu unseren Benefits und unseren Firmenwerten findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Schick uns deinen CV und zwei, drei Sätze dazu: Welche Kennzahl würdest du bei uns als Erstes verbindlich definieren, und warum ausgerechnet die? So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit unserem CFO, dann eine fachliche Session an einem anonymisierten Fall aus unserem Marktplatz, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team. Fragen? Direkt an Katharina. Let's get it muvn. 🚀 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Obsolete (E&amp;O) analysis while preparing balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and accrued purchases/prepaid manufacturing schedules for US and EMEA operations.</li> <li>Supports internal and external audits across US GAAP, local German GAAP, and SOX controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4 to 6 years of relevant cost accounting experience in a manufacturing or high-tech operational environment.</li> <li>Experience with inventory controls and multi-entity global structures.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German <em>Ausbildung</em>, e.g., <em>Industriekaufmann/-frau</em>, with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).</li> <li>Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.</li> <li>Professional fluency in both English and German.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB).</li> <li>Direct hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>November 13, 2026 at 11:59p PT</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. description: Allgemeine Infos StoryMachine wurde 2017 in Berlin gegründet und gilt als eine der profiliertesten unabhängigen Kommunikationsagenturen Deutschlands. Mit einem Team aus ehemaligen Chefredakteuren, PR-Experten, Strategen und Kreativen kommunizieren wir für ihre Kunden auf allen gängigen Plattformen. Zu unseren Kunden zählen internationale, börsennotierte Unternehmen, Familienunternehmen aus dem Mittelstand, Parteien, Verbände, Venture Capitals, Family Offices und öffentlichen Stellen aus dem In- und Ausland. StoryMachine übernimmt für sie die kommunikative Positionierung in Deutschland, Krisenkommunikation, Produkt- und Markenkommunikation, Reputationsmanagement, Litigation PR und begleitet umfassende Transformationsprozesse. Eigentümer von StoryMachine sind die beiden Gründer Kai Diekmann und Philipp Jessen, Uwe Nickl, CEO Christian Stenzel und Michael Paustian. Über die Stelle Als Werkstudent:in Modern Politics unterstützt du direkt den Head of Modern Politics und sein Team bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung integrierter Kommunikationsstrategien für KundInnen aus Politik und Public Affairs. Das bringst du mit ✅ Laufendes Studium – Du bist eingeschriebene r Student in, idealerweise in Politikwissenschaft, Kommunikationswissenschaft, Public Affairs oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. ✅ Politisches Interesse – Du interessierst dich für Politik, aktuelle gesellschaftliche Debatten und das politische Berlin. ✅ Digitale Kompetenz – Du gehst sicher mit MS Office um und hast Erfahrung mit Social-Media-Plattformen. ✅ Strukturierte Arbeitsweise – Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert und gehst mit sensiblen Informationen diskret um. ✅ Teamgeist – Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen und gehst offen auf Menschen zu. ✅ Starke Kommunikation – Du überzeugst mit klarer, freundlicher Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich – und bringst eine positive Ausstrahlung mit. ✅ Sprachsicherheit – Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch (C2/Muttersprachniveau) und verfügst über mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse. Warum StoryMachine ⭐ Netzwerk & Miteinander – Ob beim wöchentlichen Teamlunch, bei regelmäßigen Events oder über interne Netzwerke: Bei uns findest du Anschluss und echte Verbindungen. ⭐ Wissen & Entwicklung – In unserer internen kostenlosen Academy erwarten dich relevante Weiterbildungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen. ⭐ Persönliche Entwicklung – Du bekommst von Anfang an Verantwortung und Aufgaben, die dich herausfordern und fördern. ⭐ Feedback-Kultur – Regelmäßige Gespräche und ein konstruktiver Dialog auf Augenhöhe gehören bei uns dazu. ⭐ Teamgeist – Ein herzliches, diverses Team, wöchentliche Lunches & gemeinsame Events stärken unser Miteinander. ✉️ Let’s talk! With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on</strong>: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first:&nbsp;</strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Das bewegst du&nbsp;</h2> <p>Als <strong>Associate Director Business Management - Media Investment (Mensch)</strong> verantwortest du die Kundensteuerung in Investment Themen.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Kundenbudget-Monitoring:</strong>&nbsp;Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Monitoring der Kundenbudgets.</li> <li><strong>Strategische Zusammenarbeit:</strong>&nbsp;Eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Planung und Beratung bei strategischen und taktischen Fragestellungen zeichnet deine Arbeit aus.</li> <li><strong>Forecast Management:</strong>&nbsp;Das Forecast Tracking und die Validierung gehören ebenfalls in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.</li> <li><strong>Rentabilitäts-Tracking:</strong>&nbsp;Die Verantwortung für das Tracking der Kundenrentabilität liegt bei dir.</li> <li><strong>Vertragsmanagement:</strong>&nbsp;Das Management von Verträgen (Media KPIs) in Zusammenarbeit mit Kundenteams und Fachabteilungen liegt in deiner Hand.</li> <li><strong>Team-Entwicklung:</strong>&nbsp;Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst auch die Aus- und Weiterbildung der Planungsteams in Business- und Investmentthemen.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Das zeichnet dich aus&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Berufserfahrung:</strong>&nbsp;Du bringst eine mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Mediaplanung, -beratung oder im Investment Management mit, sei es von Agentur-, Beratungs- oder Kundenseite.</li> <li><strong>Analytische Fähigkeiten:</strong>&nbsp;Dein ausgeprägtes analytisches Verständnis und die Begeisterung für Zahlen und Daten zeichnen dich aus.</li> <li><strong>Präsentationsstärke:</strong>&nbsp;Komplexe Zusammenhänge kannst du zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten und überzeugend präsentieren.</li> <li><strong>Durchsetzungsvermögen:</strong>&nbsp;Deine Durchsetzungsstärke und dein geschicktes Verhandlungsgeschick hast du bereits erfolgreich unter Beweis gestellt.</li> <li><strong>Arbeitsweise:</strong>&nbsp;Teamorientiertes Arbeiten, eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, Kontaktstärke, runden dein Profil ab.</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du:&nbsp;<strong>#innovativ #teamorientiert</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur title: Senior Technical Product Manager (IntelliJ Kotlin Plugin)
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. The Kotlin plugin for IntelliJ IDEA is where language meets experience — it's how hundreds of thousands of developers write, navigate, refactor, and understand Kotlin code every day. Being able to continuously improve it means understanding the language deeply, using the product daily, and deeply caring about Kotlin developers.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who will own the Kotlin-in-IDE experience end to end. This is a deeply hands-on role. You will experiment with Kotlin in IntelliJ based IDEs every day, maintain reference projects that double as regression canaries and demo showcases, build prototypes with AI coding agents, analyze users feedback and talk to users. You won't manage from slides — you'll manage from the editor.</p> <h3><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the product vision for the Kotlin plugin: fast, correct, and trustworthy IDE support that evolves with the language.</li> <li>Use IntelliJ IDEA with the Kotlin plugin daily — dogfooding features, catching regressions, and validating the developer experience first-hand.</li> <li>Maintain and develop reference Kotlin projects that serve as showcases for new features, material for conference demos, and a living test bed for DX quality.</li> <li>Build prototypes and proofs-of-concept using AI coding agents to explore and validate new capabilities.</li> <li>Own and continuously adapt the plugin roadmap across short-term release goals, mid-term initiatives, and longer-term Kotlin ecosystem related projects.</li> <li>Align plugin planning with Kotlin compiler releases, IntelliJ IDEA release trains, and Android Studio constraints.</li> <li>Make explicit trade-offs and say "no" when cost, risk, or maintenance burden outweighs user value.</li> <li>Define problem statements, success criteria, and scope for features — then collaborate with engineers to validate and refine.</li> <li>Represent core Kotlin personas — JVM backend developers, library authors, Android and Multiplatform teams — and prioritize recurring pain points: false positives, slow analysis, unreliable refactorings, onboarding pain points,&nbsp; AI agents integrations.</li> <li>Run a consistent pipeline of monthly user interviews to ground decisions in real workflows.</li> <li>Coordinate with Kotlin language team, Developer Advocates, framework partners, Marketing, and other JetBrains teams.</li> <li>Create external visibility through what's-new posts, Kotlin User Groups meetup talks, and feature previews at events like KotlinConf, Spring I/O, Devoxx and others.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We're looking for someone who:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Has professional software development experience in Java or Kotlin (this is a must).</li> <li>Has 5+ years of experience in technical product management or a comparable role in a complex technical domain.</li> <li>Is a hands-on product person who lives in the product, not someone who operates through reports and meetings alone.</li> <li>Has experience with AI coding tools and agents, and curiosity about how they reshape developer workflows.</li> <li>Can define clear roadmaps with problem statements, success criteria, and explicit trade-offs.</li> <li>Has strong communication skills in English — written and spoken — for both technical peers and executive audiences.</li> <li>Is ready to represent the product externally at conferences, in blog posts, and in community interactions.</li> <li>Takes developer experience personally — not as an abstract metric, but as something they feel in their own daily workflow.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We'd be especially thrilled if you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Have experience developing IntelliJ plugins or working with the IntelliJ Platform SDK.</li> <li>Have built or contributed to evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, or quality measurement systems.</li> <li>Have given technical talks or published content aimed at developer audiences.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why join JetBrains?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.</li> <li>Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.</li> <li>Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.</li> <li>Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.</li> <li>Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.</li> <li>Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>*Some benefits may vary depending on location.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KL1&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have been striving to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We are now looking for a Senior Legal Counsel – Employment Law, based in Germany, to provide expert legal support on German employment law and contribute to employment-related matters across JetBrains’ global operations. The role involves supporting HR in managing sensitive workplace situations, contributing to the development and implementation of employment practices that align with legal standards and business needs, and advising on employee representation structures.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to HR<strong> </strong>on sensitive and complex employee pragmatic counsel to the Group Counsel – Labor Law, General Counsel, and the HR team, with a primary focus on German labor law and broader support across JetBrains’ operations.</li> <li>Handle a wide practices.</li> <li>Stay abreast of legislative changes in German labor law and provide legal training and knowledge-sharing sessions to internal stakeholders, particularly HR and management.</li> <li>Represent JetBrains in communications with German regulatory and government bodies on employment-related matters.</li> <li>Collaborate with legal colleagues across the global team on projects and issues that intersect with employment and labor law.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken.</li> <li>A law degree title: Customer Success Associate - Renewable Energy
description: Customer Success Associate – Renewable Energy Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Customer-Success-Teams. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industrieunternehmen mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit unserem integrierten Ansatz aus Energieversorgung, moderner Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligenter Optimierung des Energieverbrauchs helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen. Als Customer Success Associate unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen dabei, den vollen Mehrwert aus unserem nachhaltigen Produktportfolio zu ziehen. Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Betreuung, koordinierst wichtige Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich mit trawa arbeiten. Das Team Unser Customer Success Team begleitet Kund:innen von der ersten Anfrage bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft – mit dem Ziel, echten Mehrwert zu liefern, Wachstum im Bestand zu treiben und exzellenten Service zu skalieren. Wir stehen unseren Kund:innen nicht nur operativ zur Seite, sondern beraten sie auch aktiv zu Fragen rund um den Energiemarkt – damit sie in einem komplexen, volatilen Umfeld die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Operations zusammen und bist mittendrin, wenn es darum geht, wie trawa seine Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich macht. Deine Aufgaben Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust unsere Kund:innen persönlich und sorgst dafür, dass sie langfristig zufrieden und erfolgreich mit unseren Produkten arbeiten. Onboarding begleiten: Du unterstützt neue Kund:innen bei ihrem Einstieg in das trawa-Universum, koordinierst den Onboarding-Prozess und begleitest die Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle benötigten Informationen vorliegen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen eingebunden sind. Teamübergreifend arbeiten: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kolleg:innen aus Product und Sales gestaltest du eine Customer Experience, die unsere Kund:innen begeistert. Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Du bearbeitest und priorisierst eingehende Kundenanfragen, löst Probleme zeitnah und eigenständig oder leitest sie strukturiert an die zuständige Customer Success Managerin weiter. Datenqualität sicherstellen: Du pflegst Kundendaten in unseren Systemen, zum Beispiel im CRM, und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher. Reports und QBRs vorbereiten: Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung interner Meetings, Kunden-QBRs und relevanter Reportings. Nach wem wir suchen Dein Hintergrund Du hast ein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit guten Leistungen abgeschlossen. Erste Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von B2B-Kund:innen, in analytischen Tätigkeiten oder in koordinativen Rollen sind von Vorteil. Deine Fähigkeiten Du bist ein Organisationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren. Du verfügst über exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und gehst professionell sowie serviceorientiert auf Kund:innen zu – schriftlich und mündlich. Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich im Umgang mit Zahlen wohl und kannst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher und verständlich kommunizieren. Dein technisches Verständnis Du bist technologieaffin. CRM-Systeme und digitale Tools sind für dich keine Hürde, sondern eine spannende Herausforderung. Erste Erfahrungen in der Energiebranche sind ein Plus. Idealerweise interessierst du dich für erneuerbare Energien und möchtest dich in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln. Deine Sprachkenntnisse Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Du verfügst über fließende Englischkenntnisse. Weitere europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil. Deine ersten 90 Tage: Monat 1: Einarbeitung und Orientierung Du lernst trawas Produkte, Prozesse und den Energiemarkt kennen. Du verstehst, wie Kundenbeziehungen bei trawa funktionieren – vom Onboarding bis zum QBR. Du baust erste Beziehungen zu Kund:innen und internen Stakeholdern auf. Du wirst von erfahrenen Customer Success Manager:innen begleitet und übernimmst erste eigene Aufgaben in der Kundenbetreuung. Monat 2: Erste Verantwortung übernehmen Du übernimmst eigenständig erste Kundenaccounts und wirst zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson für operative Stakeholder. Du arbeitest mit bestehenden Playbooks, QBR-Vorlagen und Tools und wirst zunehmend sicherer in der selbstständigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen und -themen. Monat 3 und danach: Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Bestandskund:innen end to end. Du erkennst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Kund:innen noch besser betreuen und ihre Erfahrungen mit trawa weiter verbessern können. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben. Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte und Kundenerlebnisse, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstands beitragen. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss, und du kannst stolz auf deine Ergebnisse sein. Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Büro fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur, in der wir gerne gemeinsam arbeiten. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls möglich. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und bis zu zehn Workation-Tagen unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche Entwicklung: Du wirst Teil eines tollen Teams, in dem Coaching und Mentoring großgeschrieben werden. Außerdem arbeitest du mit modernen Technologien und lernst von erfahrenen Expert:innen aus der Branche. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior AI/ML Consultant
description: About us Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. We are a network organization of more than 2 000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. Netlight has been awarded several times as top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity and equality within the IT industry. Today we are growing all across Europe, currently with more than 13 active international offices.   The role As a Senior AI/ML Consultant, you are the person clients trust to turn AI ambition into production reality. You design and build AI systems that hold up beyond the demo. Machine learning pipelines, generative AI solutions, and the technical foundations that let organisations extract real value from AI. Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is a principled approach to system design, a genuine curiosity about the business problems behind each model, seeing work through from the first experiment to a system running in production. Across engagements, you may work as an ML engineer, AI architect, LLM/GenAI specialist, or a strategic advisor, often a combination of several within one engagement.   What the work looks like Building AI systems, shaping strategy. You design, build, and operationalise AI systems across the full stack, from data pipelines and feature engineering to LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. You use MLOps practices to bring models into production reliably and keep them there. And you work with clients to make the decisions that matter: build versus buy, model selection, responsible AI, and the organisational change that turns AI from a pilot into a practice. Delivering, leading, growing. You are growing as a consultant and a leader, not just delivering on the technical side. As a senior consultant, you are expected to take ownership beyond your immediate delivery: guiding junior colleagues, contributing to engagement quality, and beginning to build the presence and trust that defines the next stage of your career. Beyond client projects, you are will to contribute to Netlight's thought leadership within Data & AI, whether through internal knowledge sharing, external publications, or coaching colleagues who are earlier in their journey. What we offer Possibility to be part of growing one of the most successful tech consultancies in the industry. Diverse client landscape, including some of the most innovative tech companies & exciting projects with lots of room for professional development. Access to an international network of 2,000+ highly talented individuals. An experienced mentor and a professional coach to guide you throughout your career. An international & diverse working environment with a central and modern office space. Competitive and transparent salary model with equal pay regardless of the assignment, biannual salary reviews, and attractive benefits (e.g. company shares, Deutschlandticket, parental benefits & much more). The freedom to shape your own path in terms of clients, domains, and roles, supported by a global community. Access to Netlight's Edge network with its competence cells, conferences, and a culture where sharing knowledge is as valued as acquiring it. You are encouraged to contribute to Netlight's thought leadership within Data & AI. Minimum qualifications Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology (e.g., Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar). Verbal and written fluency in English. 2–4 years of full-time work experience in machine learning engineering, applied AI, or a closely related field. About us

Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. We are a network organization of more than 2 000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. Netlight has been awarded several times as top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity and equality within the IT industry. Today we are growing all across Europe, currently with more than 13 active international offices.

 

The role

As a Senior AI/ML Consultant, you are the person clients trust to turn AI ambition into production reality. You design and build AI systems that hold up beyond the demo. Machine learning pipelines, generative AI solutions, and the technical foundations that let organisations extract real value from AI.

Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is a principled approach to system design, a genuine curiosity about the business problems behind each model, seeing work through from the first experiment to a system running in production. Across engagements, you may work as an ML engineer, AI architect, LLM/GenAI specialist, or a strategic advisor, often a combination of several within one engagement.

 

What the work looks like

Building AI systems, shaping strategy. You design, build, and operationalise AI systems across the full stack, from data pipelines and feature engineering to LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. You use MLOps practices to bring models into production reliably and keep them there. And you work with clients to make the decisions that matter: build versus buy, model selection, responsible AI, and the organisational change that turns AI from a pilot into a practice.

Delivering, leading, growing. You are growing as a consultant and a leader, not just delivering on the technical side. As a senior consultant, you are expected to take ownership beyond your immediate delivery: guiding junior colleagues, contributing to engagement quality, and beginning to build the presence and trust that defines the next stage of your career. Beyond client projects, you are will to contribute to Netlight's thought leadership within Data & AI, whether through internal knowledge sharing, external publications, or coaching colleagues who are earlier in their journey.

    • Strong hands-on experience with the full ML lifecycle: data preparation, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

About the role

As a Data Platform & Data Architecture Consultant, you are the person clients trust to turn their data infrastructure from a bottleneck into a competitive advantage. You design data landscapes, stand up and scale cloud data platforms, and set the guardrails that let entire organisations build on data safely and efficiently.

Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is structural thinking, a drive to understand the business context behind every technical decision, and the ability to operate across both the blueprint and the build. Across engagements, you may operate as a data architect, lead a platform build, or contribute at the strategic advisory level, often blending several of these roles within a single engagement.

 

What the work looks like

Building and operating platforms. You design, provision, and harden cloud data platforms end to end, covering storage and compute, networking, security and IAM, observability, and cost. You codify infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation and establish governance frameworks such as data catalogs, data contracts, RBAC models, and SLAs that let organisations scale data access without losing control. You build platforms that multiple teams and business domains can rely on, not just at launch, but as they grow.

Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. This can mean designing a target-state architecture for a client migrating from legacy systems to a modern cloud lakehouse, or defining domain boundaries and data product interfaces in a data mesh adoption.

Advising and translating. You sit at the intersection of technology and business. You work with data engineers, data scientists, product owners, and senior client stakeholders to understand what they need, then turn that into platform strategy and architecture decisions. You are the person a CTO trusts to make the right call on how their data infrastructure should evolve.

  • Assess where deterministic logic is the better solution and implement it accordingly

In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement.
 
Life at TodayTix Group
We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.
 
New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development.
 
Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. 
 
We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply.

About the Role: 

Powered by TodayTix (PxT) is TodayTix Group's enterprise ticketing and e-commerce division — the technology and tools that help the world's leading cultural organisations, attractions, and live events power their box office and drive online sales. We work with some of the most exciting venues, producers, and event organisers on the planet, and we're building the platform that helps them thrive.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the PxT team — someone who thrives on data, moves fast, and is obsessed with identifying friction and building products that meaningfully improve how people discover, buy, and experience live events.

You'll own product discovery and delivery for a key area of our platform, working directly with producers and event organisers to understand their needs, shape solutions, and bring them to life alongside world-class engineering and design teams.

You instinctively reach for AI to think, prototype, validate ideas, and accelerate learning. You'll often start with ambiguity rather than requirements and enjoy identifying opportunities, forming hypotheses, and turning ideas into action.

Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. 
 
We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply.

About the Role: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join TodayTix Group and own how we scale our data platform — the backbone connecting product, growth, finance, and CX to a single source of truth, plus increasingly the substrate AI tooling across the company queries directly. You'll lead the team that owns the project end-to-end — staging, intermediates, and marts — plus the CI/CD pipeline and Snowflake platform underneath it.

This is a technical leadership role, not a heads-down modelling one — most of your time goes to architecture, review, technical strategy, and cross-functional leadership, with hands-on modelling a deliberate minority. You lead by setting direction, raising the team's bar, and owning delivery, quality, and stakeholder trust across a high-demand roadmap.

The foundation is built — your job is what gets built on top of it as the org scales. TTG is expanding as part of MARI, bringing new portfolio companies' event and ticketing data onto the platform; PxT (our partner-facing product) is growing its surface area; and the business keeps adding markets and brands. You'll design how the platform absorbs that growth — new sources, new consumers, higher stakes — without the architecture buckling.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, measure your impact by the team's, not just your own, and care as much about business impact as technical craft, we'd love to hear from you — especially if, like the rest of the team, you reach for AI by default.

    • What You'll Do:

  • Own the data platform end-to-end — the dbt project (staging → intermediates → marts), CI/CD, and the Snowflake infrastructure it runs on.

  • Design and lead the onboarding of new data sources onto the platform as TTG scales, so growth doesn't mean architectural debt.

  • Run intake and prioritisation across a high-demand roadmap where reporting, growth analytics, and AI-tooling initiatives compete for the same team's time — sequence against business objectives, and say no well.

  • Cloud data warehouse depth. Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable MPP warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery).

  • Experience scaling a data platform through growth — onboarding new business units, acquisitions, or data sources onto an existing model without rearchitecting from scratch. (M&A / multi-entity data integration experience is directly relevant given the evolving company structure.)

  • Full-stack data platform judgement. Comfortable across ingestion (CDC/replication from operational databases, event pipelines), transformation (dbt), and consumption (BI tools, reverse ETL, AI/agent access) — even where you're not the one writing every layer.

  • Strong architecture and code review. You set technical direction through sound data-model design and give review that makes engineers better.

  • Stakeholder management. You partner with product, finance, growth, and CX — translating messy source data into models people trust, and setting expectations as priorities shift.

  • A product and business mindset. You measure success by the decisions your data enabled, not rows modelled.

In this role, you will work as a key member of the Ads Customer Interfaces team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What is the role?</h3> <p>Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television and streaming media worldwide, continued success stems from experienced software engineers like you developing core features for the Roku platform.</p> <p>Our new Senior Software Engineer will be contributing extensively to our container orchestrated platform, bringing together some of the latest web technologies with Ai expertise to develop a truly scalable and responsive web applications. This is a great role for a senior professional who enjoys a high level of visibility and thrives on great business impact.</p> <p>The features and performance improvements you implement directly impact millions of users every day. This is a great role for an experienced professional who has innovative ideas for complex problems and can translate these ideas into ultra-reliable software.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>How will I use AI at Roku?</h3> <p>&nbsp;<br>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What are the responsiblities of the role?&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and deliver high-quality web applications and back-end services with modern frameworks and technologies.</li> <li>Work as a part of a high functioning team consisting of UX designers, software engineers, dev-ops, quality assurance and product management.</li> <li>Build and integrate AI-powered features into web applications and enterprise tools.</li> <li>Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to power chatbot interactions</li> <li>Work both independently and paired with other team members to ensure efficient delivery of prioritised features.</li> <li>Take part in the planning and refinement of features along with the team to come up with innovative and collaborative designs.</li> <li>Develop new features and write test cases to ensure the quality of your code.</li> <li>Work with CI/CD tools to ensure that all software developed adheres to both quality and scaling requirements.</li> <li>Take a role in continuously improving our software delivery process, making it as efficient as possible, reducing wasteful activities and creating value.</li> <li>See a feature go all the way from design stage to being deployed into customer facing environments.</li> <li>Demonstrate the ability to dig deep to find solutions to challenging problems affecting our users.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive expeirence&nbsp; in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Express) on cloud-based technology, such as AWS and GCP.</li> <li>Experience of building large scale and low latency distributed systems.</li> <li>Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, performance optimisation techniques, object-oriented programming.</li> <li>Experience using modern AI-assisted and agentic development workflows in day-to-day engineering using&nbsp;AI/ML APIs and SDKs</li> <li>Hands-on experience developing RAG solutions or working with LLMs for chatbots is preferred</li> <li>In-depth understanding of CI/CD and the tools used to implement them, such as Jenkins.</li> <li>Experience with software repository tools, such as GitLab and GitHub.</li> <li>Experience with productivity tools, such as Jira and Confluence.</li> <li>A good understanding of Agile practices.</li> <li>Ability to accurately estimate software tasks and work to schedule.</li> <li>Exposure to observability tools and practices (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) are preferred.</li> <li>Understanding of databases and data architecture choices (SQL vs NoSQL, caching layers, and data access patterns)</li> <li>Track record of tuning performance and reliability for highly available services and web applications</li> <li>Familiarity with web security fundamentals and secure engineering practices</li> <li>Bachelors of Masters Degree in Compute Science/Software Engineering or related subject</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-PA1</strong></p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • The problem is real, and the scale is global. The supply chain industry moves $19 trillion of goods a year. We're building the AI workforce that makes it run smarter. Your work will matter.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal.
